feats.benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throw DCs when using maneuvers of the selected discipline. You also inflict an additional +2 points of damage when wielding associated weapons of the chosen discipline.
feats.special: If the character ever has fewer than three maneuvers known from the specialized discipline, then he loses the benefits of this feat until such a time that he does. This feat may be selected multiple times, each time selecting a new discipline to receive the benefits of this feat.

feats.name: Discipline Mastery
feats.description: You've learned to use certain skills in reference to your martial ability with practiced ease.
feats.prerequisites_text: 8 or more ranks in a discipline's associated skill.

prerequisites.text: 8 or more ranks in a discipline's associated skill

feats.benefit: You may take 10 on skill checks made with any associated skill of a discipline you possess (with 8 or more ranks) without increasing the time needed to make the check, even if combat or distractions would otherwise prevent you from doing so.

feats.name: Double Weapon Finesse
feats.description: You have mastered ways to take a double weapon and turn it into a spinning majesty of deadly grace.
feats.prerequisites_text: Proficiency with one or more double weapons, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse.

prerequisites.text: Proficiency with one or more double weapons

feats.benefit: While wielding a double weapon that you are proficient in, you may treat both heads of the weapon as light weapons for the purposes of the Weapon Finesse feat and for Two-Weapon Fighting. You also receive a +2 competence bonus to CMD when using a double weapon.

feats.name: Electrum Manticore
feats.description: You've learned how to blend the arts of the Golden Lion and Silver Crane disciplines.
feats.prerequisites_text: Two Golden Lion maneuvers known, two Silver Crane maneuvers known.
feats.benefit: You can initiate a Golden Lion boost as part of entering a Silver Crane stance, and can initiate a Silver Crane boost as part of entering a Golden Lion stance.

feats.name: Elemental Current
feats.description: You've learned how to blend the skills of the Elemental Flux discipline with that of Mithral Current.
feats.prerequisites_text: Quick Draw, two Elemental Flux maneuvers known, two Mithral Current maneuvers known.
feats.benefit: Whenever you use a Mithral Current strike or stance to make a creature vulnerable to silver, you can instead make that creature vulnerable to your active element's associated energy type. Creatures with vulnerability to an energy type take half again as much (+50%) damage as normal from that energy type, as normal. If your target is normally immune to that energy type, they instead take half damage from that energy type instead of none for as long as they are vulnerable.

feats.name: Elemental Flux Explosion
feats.description: Your strikes explode with elemental ferocity.
feats.prerequisites_text: Elemental Flux Style, Elemental Flux Shift, Spellcraft 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: Your weapons gain the benefit of the elemental burst weapon special ability appropriate to your active element's associated energy type (for example, your weapons would gain the benefit of the flaming burst weapon special ability if your active element is fire). This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Elemental Flux Shift
feats.description: Your insight into the elements expands, allowing you to fuse disparate energies.
feats.prerequisites_text: Elemental Flux Style, Spellcraft 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: When you change your active element, your next attack before the start of your next turn deals additional damage equal to your highest initiation modifier of your previous active element's associated energy type. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Elemental Flux Style
feats.description: You understand the fluid and changing nature of elemental magics.
feats.prerequisites_text: Spellcraft 3 ranks, one Elemental Flux stance known.
feats.benefit: You can change your active element once per round as a free action.

feats.name: Elemental Focus
feats.description: You have chosen a singular element with which to excel.
feats.prerequisites_text: Elemental attunement class feature or one Elemental Flux maneuver known.

prerequisites.text: Elemental attunement class feature or one Elemental Flux maneuver known

feats.benefit: Choose one element available as an active element for the Elemental Flux discipline. When this element is your active element, your maneuvers that deal damage of that element's associated energy type ignore up to your character level in energy resistance. In addition, starting at character level 10th, creatures that are immune to that element's energy type take half damage instead of none from your attacks and abilities.

feats.name: Elemental Sun
feats.description: You can blend your techniques with the Elemental Flux and Solar Wind disciplines.
feats.prerequisites_text: Two Elemental Flux maneuvers known, two Solar Wind maneuvers known.
feats.benefit: When you hit with an attack as part of a Solar Wind maneuver while maintaining an Elemental Flux stance, you can reduce your target's resistances to acid, cold, electricity, and fire by 1/2 your initiator level for one round. Multiple uses of this ability do not stack; instead, the duration increases by one round.

feats.name: Enduring Protector
feats.description: Your determination to win grows with defeated foe.
feats.prerequisites_text: Combat Reflexes, Martial Power.
feats.benefit: Whenever you reduce an opponent to 0 or fewer hit points with an attack of opportunity, you gain temporary hit points equal to that opponent's Hit Dice or the amount of temporary hit points you would normally gain when you use the Martial Power feat, whichever is higher. These temporary hit points do not stack with themselves, and last for one round.

feats.name: Eternal Guardian Endurance
feats.description: You feed on the energy of fallen foes to renew your combat abilities.
feats.prerequisites_text: Eternal Guardian Style, Eternal Guardian Oath, Intimidate 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: Once per round, when you reduce a cursed opponent to 0 or fewer hit points, you can recover an expended maneuver as a free action.

feats.name: Eternal Guardian Oath
feats.description: You presence impairs the ability to fight of those you have cursed.
feats.prerequisites_text: Eternal Guardian Style, Intimidate 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: You can expend a readied counter as an immediate action to cause cursed creatures you threaten to take a -4 penalty on attack rolls against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Eternal Guardian Style
feats.description: Your combat maneuvers are empowered by psychic curses.
feats.prerequisites_text: Intimidate 3 ranks, one Eternal Guardian stance known.
feats.benefit: Whenever you succeed on a combat maneuver attempt against an opponent, they become cursed for one round. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Eternal Hourglass
feats.prerequisites_text: Two Eternal Guardian maneuvers known, two Riven Hourglass maneuvers known.
feats.benefit: Once per encounter, while you maintain a Riven Hourglass stance, you can initiate an Eternal Guardian counter as a free action rather than an immediate action (even if it isn't your turn).

feats.name: Extended Mark
feats.description: Your marks are more potent and are capable of keeping your foe's attention longer.
feats.prerequisites_text: Armiger's mark class feature
feats.benefit: The duration of your armiger's mark is doubled.

feats.name: Extra Animus
feats.description: Your reserves of animus are stronger.
feats.prerequisites_text: Must possess an animus pool.
feats.benefit: Your initial animus pool at the start of each combat increases by 2 points.
feats.special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each additional time you take the feat, your initial animus pool increases by 1 point instead of 2.

feats.name: Extra Conviction
feats.description: You've more conviction than that of your fellows.
feats.prerequisites_text: Conviction class feature.
feats.benefit: Choose a conviction that you meet the prerequisites for. You gain the benefit of that conviction.
feats.special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you take the feat, you choose an additional conviction you meet the prerequisites for.

feats.name: Extra Gambit
feats.description: You have learned another manner in which to take a chance for success.
feats.prerequisites_text: The ability to initiate a gambit, Cha 13, 3rd-level warlord.

prerequisites.text: The ability to initiate a gambit

feats.benefit: You may select another gambit method in which to regain maneuvers.
feats.special: You may select this feat multiple times, selecting a new gambit each time.

feats.name: Extra Granted Maneuver
feats.description: You're quite capable at sorting through your flashes of mystic inspiration for maneuvers you need.
feats.prerequisites_text: Granted maneuvers, initiator level 3rd.
feats.benefit: When you are granted your maneuvers at the start of combat and after you expend all your remaining maneuvers, you can choose one additional maneuver to be granted from your withheld maneuvers.
feats.normal: Your granted maneuvers are equal to your normal allotment, and any granted maneuvers beyond the ones you are allowed to select are randomly determined.

feats.name: Extra Marks
feats.description: You are able to mark more opponents than most.
feats.prerequisites_text: Armiger's mark class feature.
feats.benefit: You gain two additional daily uses of your armiger's mark class feature.
feats.special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Its effects stack.

feats.name: Extra Presence
feats.prerequisites_text: Tactical presence class feature.
feats.benefit: Choose a tactical presence that you meet the prerequisites for. You can assume that tactical presence when you use your tactical presence class feature.
feats.special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you take the feat, you choose an additional tactical presence you meet the prerequisites for. You can select tactical presences normally available only to a specific warlord archetype with this feat even if you do not possess that archetype.

feats.name: Extra Readied Maneuver
feats.description: You have learned how to increase your ability to maintain martial forms in your mind.
feats.prerequisites_text: Ability to initiate a martial maneuver.

prerequisites.text: Ability to initiate a martial maneuver

feats.benefit: Choose a martial disciple class you have levels in. Your maneuvers readied for that class increases by one. If that class has granted maneuvers (such as the mystic), the number of maneuvers you are granted at the beginning of an encounter and when you recover your maneuvers also increases by one.
feats.special: You may select this feat multiple times, applying it to multiple classes (if you possess multiple initiator classes) or multiple times to single class. This feat may not alter maneuvers readied from the Martial Training feat chain.

feats.name: Extra Stalker Art
feats.description: You've learned a new way to use your stalker training.
feats.prerequisites_text: 3rd-level stalker, Wis 13.
feats.benefit: You may select a new stalker art and add it to your known stalker arts.
feats.special: You may select this feat multiple times, selecting a new stalker art each time.

feats.name: Feral Goddess
feats.description: Your use of the Sleeping Goddess discipline enhances your psionically-generated natural weapons.
feats.prerequisites_text: One Sleeping Goddess maneuver known, ability to manifest a psionic power that grants natural weapons (such as claws of the beast or metamorphosis).

prerequisites.text: ability to manifest a psionic power that grants natural weapons (such as claws of the beast or metamorphosis)

feats.benefit: You reduce the power point cost for manifesting a power that grants you a natural weapon by 1 (to a minimum of 0). In addition, you treat natural weapons created by psionic powers as Sleeping Goddess discipline weapons and as magic weapons for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction.

feats.name: Flowing Mithral Fist
feats.description: You have learned how to make your unassuming hands and feet into swift moving, deadly weapons.
feats.prerequisites_text: Improved Unarmed Strike, one Mithral Current stance known.
feats.benefit:
You treat unarmed strikes as
Mithral Current discipline weapons and as silver weapons for the purposes of overcoming
damage reduction or dealing additional damage to a creature
vulnerable to silver. In addition, you can sheath your hands once per round as a
free action that does not provoke
attacks of opportunity (even if it isn't your turn) by placing them in your pockets, under your sleeves, or in an otherwise non-threatening position.

feats.name: Forge of the Goddess
feats.description: Your ability to call forth psionically-generated weapons is tempered by your skill with the Sleeping Goddess discipline.
feats.prerequisites_text: One Sleeping Goddess maneuver known, ability to manifest call weaponry.
feats.benefit: You treat any weapon you create with the call weaponry power as a Sleeping Goddess discipline weapon. In addition, you reduce the power point cost for manifesting call weaponry by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

feats.name: Fuse Styles
feats.description: You are capable of mingling mundane and martial combat styles.
feats.prerequisites_text: One Style feat, one stance known.
feats.benefit: You can enter a fighting style and a martial stance with the same swift action.

feats.name: Giant Slayer
feats.description: You know how to turn a foe's size and reach against them.
feats.benefit: When you make a charge attack, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target of your charge. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls made during charges for each size category larger than you the target of the attack is.

feats.name: Golden Lion Charge
feats.description: Your awareness of the battlefield lets you seize opportunity at a moment's notice.
feats.prerequisites_text: Golden Lion Style, Diplomacy 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever an opponent within 30 feet misses an ally with an attack, you can expend a readied counter as an immediate action to move up to your speed towards that opponent, provided you end your movement with that opponent within your melee reach, and make an attack of opportunity against them.
feats.special: A character can choose this feat in place of a bonus teamwork feat they would gain.

feats.name: Golden Lion Command
feats.description: Your battlefield presence bolsters the will of your allies.
feats.prerequisites_text: Golden Lion Style, Golden Lion Charge, Diplomacy 11 ranks
feats.benefit: You can expend a readied boost as a swift action to grant all allies within 30 feet 5 temporary hit points each time you make an attack this round. These temporary hit points stack with themselves and last for one round.
feats.special: A character can choose this feat in place of a bonus teamwork feat they would gain.

feats.name: Golden Lion Style
feats.description: You are adept at taking advantage of your allies' missed opportunities.
feats.prerequisites_text: Diplomacy 3 ranks, one Golden Lion stance known.
feats.benefit: Once per round, when an ally (other than yourself) misses an attack against an opponent you both flank, you can make an attack of opportunity against that opponent.
feats.special: A character can choose this feat in place of a bonus teamwork feat they would gain.

feats.name: Grasp of Darkness
feats.description: Your malicious intentions can ensnare many at once.
feats.prerequisites_text: Dark claim class feature.
feats.benefit: When you use your dark claim class feature to Claim a creature, you recover two expended maneuvers rather than one, and can Claim two additional opponents within close range. You do not recover additional maneuvers for Claiming these opponents beyond the one granted by this feat.

feats.name: Greater Unarmed Strike
feats.description: Your unarmed attacks show a master's skill.
feats.prerequisites_text: Improved Unarmed Strike, character level 3rd.
feats.benefit: Your unarmed strikes have their base damage increased to 1d8 (for a Medium size creature). At character level 10th, this increases to 1d10 base damage. If you are a monk, brawler, or other class that gains increased unarmed damage based on your level, you instead add 4 to your effective class level to determine your unarmed strike damage dice.

feats.name: Guard's Glare
feats.description: Your unflinching stare keeps your targets terrified of fleeing from you.
feats.prerequisites_text: Armiger's mark class feature, Intimidate 4 ranks.
feats.benefit: A creature that is demoralized, frightened, shaken, or panicked and marked by your armiger's mark must make a Will save (DC 10 + half your warder level + warder initiation modifier) to move in a direction away from you. A creature only needs to make this save once per round. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

feats.name: Haft Strike
feats.prerequisites_text: Base attack bonus +5
feats.benefit: You can choose to take a -2 penalty to your AC to gain the ability to threaten all opponents within the reach of your reach weapon, rather than those you would normally threaten with your weapon. You must choose to use this feat before making an attack roll during your turn, and its effects last until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Hone Weapon
feats.description: You've learned the art of bringing a fine cutting edge to your weapons.
feats.prerequisites_text: Knowledge (martial) 3 ranks.
feats.benefit: You can spend ten minutes using a whetstone to sharpen a piercing or slashing weapon or up to 20 pieces of piercing or slashing ammunition to a fine point or edge. The newly-honed weapon gains a +1 bonus on damage rolls for one day. This bonus increases by +1 at character level 4th and at every four levels thereafter. Honing a weapon has no effect on its hardness or hit points, and you may hone both magical and nonmagical weapons. You can only hone manufactured weapons with this feat.

feats.name: Improved Blade Meditation
feats.description: You've mastered the art form of your blade meditation.
feats.prerequisites_text: Blade meditation class feature, mystic level 7th.
feats.benefit: You can activate your blade meditation class feature as a standard action instead of as a full-round action.

feats.name: Improved Quick Draw
feats.prerequisites_text: Quick Draw.
feats.benefit: You are considered to be threatening all squares within reach of your weapon even if it is sheathed, and can draw your weapon when making an attack of opportunity. When you draw your weapon in this way, you may sheath weapon without provoking attacks of opportunity after the attack is resolved.

feats.name: Inner Fire
feats.description: You use psionic power to augment your rampaging elemental abilities.
feats.prerequisites_text: Gather power class feature.
feats.benefit: You can expend your psionic focus while gathering power to reduce the action needed to alleviate burn. If you take a swift action, you are treated as if you had gathered power as a move action. If you take a move action, you are treated as if you gathered power for a full round. You cannot gather power in another way in the same turn you use this feat.

feats.name: Iron Tortoise Shell
feats.description: Your shield protects you from more than just physical assaults.
feats.prerequisites_text: Iron Tortoise Style, Bluff 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever you initiate a counter, you gain evasion (as the rogue class feature) until the end of your next turn.

feats.name: Iron Tortoise Snap
feats.description: Your sword-and-shield style is brutally efficient.
feats.prerequisites_text: Iron Tortoise Style, Iron Tortoise Shell, Bluff 13 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever you hit a creature with a shield bash, you can make an attack with a different weapon at your highest base attack bonus against that creature. You can only make two additional attacks per round in this manner.

feats.name: Iron Tortoise Style
feats.description: You guard yourself and allies with your trusty shield at your side.
feats.prerequisites_text: Bluff 3 ranks, proficiency with shields, one Iron Tortoise stance known.
feats.benefit: You deal damage with shield bash attacks as though you were one size larger than you actually are. This stacks with other effects that increase you or your weapons' size.

feats.name: Kinetic Duelist
feats.description: You can create a second kinetic blade.
feats.prerequisites_text: Two-Weapon Fighting, kinetic blade wild talent.
feats.benefit: When you use the kinetic blade wild talent, you may make a second kinetic blade in your off hand. You can only make one attack with this second kinetic blade, regardless of how many off-hand attacks you would normally receive. You pay burn costs for the second kinetic blade as normal, and can make the second kinetic blade using a different kinetic blast than the first, if you wish. If you used gather power to reduce the cost of the first kinetic blade, the reduction from gather power does not apply to the second blade's cost as well.

feats.name: Lightning Recovery
feats.prerequisites_text: Ability to initiate martial maneuvers.
feats.benefit: As a free action, after you've use a martial strike, counter, or boost, you may instantly recover that maneuver. You may do this once per day.
feats.special: You may select this feat multiple times, gaining multiple uses per day.

feats.name: Lightning Swap
feats.description: Your speed is legendary, allowing you to switch weapons at a frightening pace.
feats.prerequisites_text: Quick Draw, Dex 15, base attack bonus +5.
feats.benefit: You may draw or put away a weapon as a free action. You cannot make more weapon swaps per round than your Dexterity modifier. You also gain a +2 bonus to CMD to resist attempts to be disarmed due to your fast hands and reflexes.

feats.name: Lurker in Darkness
feats.description: Your training allows you to foil even magical and unusual senses.
feats.prerequisites_text: Stealth 6 ranks.
feats.benefit: Creatures using unusual forms of sensory perception such as blindsight, greensight, or tremorsense cannot automatically foil your use of Stealth; such creatures must make a Perception check as normal to detect you when you make use of the Stealth skill. This feat foils indirect detection (such as a creature using detect magic to search for your magical items while you are using Stealth) in the manner described above, but has no effect on psi-like abilities, powers, spells, spell-like abilities, and/or supernatural abilities specifically used to uncover information about you rather than enhancing the user's perception, such as the augury spell.

feats.name: Malevolence
feats.description: Your Claim carries a hindering curse.
feats.prerequisites_text: Ability to Claim creatures.
feats.benefit: Creatures Claimed by you become cursed and take a -2 penalty on combat maneuver checks and skill checks for as long as they are Claimed.

feats.name: Martial Charge
feats.description: You have learned how to initiate a martial strike on the move, delivering them at the end of a charge attack.
feats.prerequisites_text: Base attack bonus +3, ability to initiate a martial strike.

prerequisites.text: ability to initiate a martial strike

feats.benefit: As a full-round action, you can make a special charge attack. First, move up to twice your speed in a straight line towards a creature, obeying the normal restrictions on movement during a charge, as well as applying any effects or benefits you might have to such movement. Then, at the end of your movement, you can initiate a strike on the creature you moved towards with an initiation action of 1 standard action. You gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls during the strike, and take a -2 penalty to your AC until the start of your next turn. During the strike, you do not gain any other benefits you would have gained for charging, such as pounce.

feats.name: Martial Power
feats.description: You are able to instinctively call upon reserves of untapped power within yourself to defend yourself.
feats.prerequisites_text: Constitution 13, knowledge of at least one maneuver or stance.

prerequisites.text: knowledge of at least one maneuver or stance

feats.benefit: You can choose to take a -1 penalty on attack rolls and combat maneuver checks to gain 2 temporary hit points. This bonus is increased by half (50%) when you are using a shield of any kind. When your base attack bonus reaches +3 and every +2 thereafter, the penalty increases by -1 and the temporary hit point bonus increases by 2. You can only choose to use this feat when you declare that you are making an attack or a full-attack action with a melee weapon, or when you are initiating a maneuver. The penalty to attack rolls and temporary hit points gained from use of this feat last until the start of your next turn.
feats.special: Martial Power can be used in place of Combat Expertise to qualify for a feat, prestige class, or other special ability. You can take both this feat and Combat Expertise.

feats.name: Martial Training I
feats.description: You've learned the basics in a martial discipline.
feats.prerequisites_text: Base attack bonus +3 or Knowledge (martial) 3 ranks.

prerequisites.text: Base attack bonus +3 or Knowledge (martial) 3 ranks

feats.benefit: Select a martial discipline. The associated skill for this discipline is now a class skill. Your initiation modifier is chosen from Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Your martial initiator level maneuvers granted by this feat (and subsequent Martial Training feats) is equal to half your character level + your initiation modifier. You may select any two maneuvers from the 1st level maneuvers from this discipline, and you may ready one of your maneuvers for use. You may recover one maneuver by expending a full round action to recover it.
feats.special: If you ever gain levels in a martial adept class or possess them previously, these maneuvers continue to use their own initiator level and recovery method, independent of your martial adept level. Those wishing to add new maneuvers from a discipline that is already available to their class should instead select the Advanced Study feat instead.

feats.name: Martial Training II
feats.description: You've continued to progress your martial studies.
feats.prerequisites_text: Martial Training I, base attack bonus +5 or Knowledge (martial) 5 ranks.

prerequisites.text: base attack bonus +5 or Knowledge (martial) 5 ranks

feats.benefit: You may select two new maneuvers and one stance from your chosen discipline of up to 2nd level, and you may ready an additional maneuver. You must meet the minimum initiator level to select any maneuver.

feats.name: Martial Training III
feats.description: Your mastery of your martial discipline improves.
feats.prerequisites_text: Martial Training II, base attack bonus +7 or Knowledge (martial) 7 ranks.

prerequisites.text: base attack bonus +7 or Knowledge (martial) 7 ranks

feats.benefit: You may select an additional new maneuver from your chosen discipline of up to 3rd level, plus one new stance, and you may ready an additional maneuver. You may also trade out any one maneuver from your chosen discipline you know and replace it with a different maneuver from that discipline of up to 2nd level. You must meet the minimum initiator level to select any maneuver.

feats.name: Martial Training IV
feats.description: You are fast approaching mastery of your chosen discipline.
feats.prerequisites_text: Martial Training III, base attack bonus +9 or Knowledge (martial) 9 ranks.

prerequisites.text: base attack bonus +9 or Knowledge (martial) 9 ranks

feats.benefit: You may select two new maneuvers from your chosen discipline of up to 4th level, and you may ready an additional maneuver. You must meet the minimum initiator level to select any maneuver.

feats.name: Martial Training V
feats.description: You are truly enlightened with using your chosen discipline.
feats.prerequisites_text: Martial Training IV, base attack bonus +11 or Knowledge (martial) 11 ranks.

prerequisites.text: base attack bonus +11 or Knowledge (martial) 11 ranks

feats.benefit: You may select two new maneuvers or one new maneuver and one new stance from your chosen discipline of up to 5th level, and you may ready an additional maneuver. You may also trade out any one maneuver from your chosen discipline you know and replace it with a different maneuver from that discipline of up to 4th level. You must meet the minimum initiator level to select any maneuver.

feats.name: Martial Training VI
feats.description: You have reached your limits in mastering your chosen discipline.
feats.prerequisites_text: Martial Training V, base attack bonus +13 or Knowledge (martial) 13 ranks.

prerequisites.text: base attack bonus +13 or Knowledge (martial) 13 ranks

feats.benefit: You may select two new maneuvers or one new maneuver and one new stance from your chosen discipline of up to 6th level, and you may ready an additional maneuver. You may also trade out any one maneuver from your chosen discipline you know and replace it with a different maneuver from that discipline of up to 5th level. You must meet the minimum initiator level to select any maneuver.

feats.name: Mass Murder
feats.description: You are impelled to acts of horrific violence.
feats.prerequisites_text: Massacre class feature.
feats.benefit: You can use your massacre class feature an additional time per encounter.
feats.special: You can take this feat up to two times. Its effects stack.

feats.name: Mind Afire
feats.description: You can fuel your psychic powers with the same mental fortitude that strengthens your body.
feats.prerequisites_text: Kineticist level 1st, uses an ability score other than Constitution to determine your hit points (such as by possessing the Altered Life feat).

prerequisites.text: uses an ability score other than Constitution to determine your hit points (such as by possessing the Altered Life feat)

feats.benefit: You can use the ability score you use to determine your hit points instead of your Constitution for determining how much burn you can possess, the save DCs of your kineticist class features, the bonus damage of your kinetic blasts, and any wild talent that uses your Constitution modifier to determine its effect.

feats.name: Mirror of the Moon
feats.description: You can bend light as well as space.
feats.prerequisites_text: Two Shattered Mirror maneuvers known, two Veiled Moon maneuvers known, ability to initiate maneuvers of 4th level or higher.

prerequisites.text: ability to initiate maneuvers of 4th level or higher

feats.benefit: Whenever you initiate a maneuver that allows you to teleport, you leave behind an illusory duplicate of yourself in the space you teleport from. This duplicate functions as a major image spell with a caster level equal to your initiator level, except that it only lasts for one round and does not require you to concentrate to maintain or direct it. You can only create a single duplicate with this feat at any given time. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Mithral Current Flow
feats.prerequisites_text: Mithral Current Style, Perform (dance) 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever an opponent misses an attack against you, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity as a free action, even if it isn't your turn.

feats.name: Mithral Current Slice
feats.prerequisites_text: Mithral Current Style, Mithral Current Flow, Perform (dance) 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: Your first attack in a round in which you drew a weapon deals damage to your target as if they were vulnerable to silver.
feats.normal: Creatures with vulnerability to silver take 50% more damage from silver weapons.

feats.name: Mithral Current Style
feats.description: Your dazzling and graceful motions allow you to catch foes off guard.
feats.prerequisites_text: Quick Draw, Perform (dance) 3 ranks, one Mithral Current stance known.
feats.benefit: While you have a sheathed weapon on your person, you can make a feint against an opponent within your melee reach as a swift action. You may make Perform (dance) checks in place of Bluff checks when feinting in this way.

feats.name: Mixed Combat
feats.description: You are trained at using ranged and melee attacks at the same time.
feats.prerequisites_text: Quick Draw, base attack bonus +6.
feats.benefit: You can sheathe a weapon as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, even if it isn't your turn. If you hit a creature with a melee attack, your attacks with ranged weapons until the end of your turn do not provoke attacks of opportunity from that creature.
feats.normal: Sheathing a weapon is a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity. Ranged attacks provoke attacks of opportunity.

feats.name: Molten Silver Strike
feats.description: Your powerful strikes are imbued with fiery wrath.
feats.prerequisites_text: Quick Draw, two Mithral Current maneuvers known, two Solar Wind maneuvers known.
feats.benefit: You can gain the effects of Solar Wind boosts when initiating Mithral Current strikes that allow you to attack enemies at range as a melee attack, even if those boosts would normally only function for ranged attacks. When you do so, you increase the range of the Mithral Current strike by 10 feet plus an additional 5 feet per four initiator levels you possess.
feats.normal: Mithral Current strikes that attack enemies at range are still melee attacks, and as such would not gain the benefits of Solar Wind's boosts.

feats.name: Piercing Thunder Push
feats.description: Your weapon guards you against hordes of charging foes.
feats.prerequisites_text: Piercing Thunder Style, Acrobatics 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: You can ready spears or polearms against charges as if they had the brace quality. If you hit a charging opponent with your readied weapon, you push them back 5 feet (potentially stopping their charge).

feats.name: Piercing Thunder Style
feats.description: You can use the natural reach of a spear or polearm with greater effectiveness.
feats.prerequisites_text: Acrobatics 3 ranks, one Piercing Thunder stance known.
feats.benefit: While you are wielding a reach weapon, opponents provoke an attack of opportunity from you when they enter a square you threaten. If an opponent would also provoke an attack of opportunity from leaving a threatened square when they do, they still only provoke a single attack of opportunity from you.

feats.name: Piercing Thunder Trample
feats.description: Your charges are unstoppable, even by those you strike.
feats.prerequisites_text: Piercing Thunder Style, Piercing Thunder Push, Acrobatics 13 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever you charge a creature while wielding a Piercing Thunder discipline weapon, you can make a bull rush attempt and an overrun attempt against the target of your charge. These combat maneuver attempts do not provoke attacks of opportunity, and can be made before or after your charge attack in any order.

feats.name: Pikeman's Training
feats.prerequisites_text: Base attack bonus +1.
feats.benefit: You can wield a normally two-handed polearm or spear in one hand, provided you are wielding a light or heavy shield in your other hand. When wielding a weapon in this manner, you treat it in all ways as being a one-handed weapon, rather than a weapon of its normal handedness.

feats.name: Pinning Arrow
feats.description: You are capable of such exceptional aim that you can pin a foot to the ground, or a wing to a side.
feats.prerequisites_text: Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot.
feats.benefit: You can make a pinning shot in place of an attack action or an attack as part of a full attack. When you do, make a ranged attack. If it hits, it deals no damage, but the target must succeed at a Reflex save (DC 10 + the damage your attack would have dealt) or stop in their tracks and become unable to move for one round. They can still take other actions as normal, but cannot leave their space. A flying creature that fails its saving throw falls unless it succeeds at a Fly check with the same DC as the Reflex save, potentially taking falling damage.

feats.name: Polearm Dancer
feats.description: Your motions with your spear are agile and graceful.
feats.prerequisites_text: Perform (dance) 1 rank, base attack bonus +1.
feats.benefit: You may use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier on attack rolls with spears and polearms.
feats.special: This feat counts as Weapon Finesse for purposes of meeting prerequisites and requirements.

feats.name: Powerful Mark
feats.description: Your ability to mark foes is more potent than others of your trade.
feats.prerequisites_text: Armiger's mark class feature.
feats.benefit: The penalty for your armiger's mark ability increases by 2, and the save DC for your armiger's mark grand challenge increases by +2.

feats.name: Primal Fury Leap
feats.prerequisites_text: Primal Fury Style, Primal Fury Slash, Survival 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: You can make charge attacks against opponents in the air. If you do, you are treated as having a fly speed equal to your land speed during the charge, with good maneuverability. If you do not normally have a fly speed, you fall after this charge. You reduce the effective distance of this fall by 10 feet per initiator level.

feats.name: Primal Fury Slash
feats.description: Your swift movements and skill allow you to strike enemies as you close with your target.
feats.prerequisites_text: Primal Fury Style, Survival 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: When you charge a creature, you can make a single melee attack against another creature that is adjacent to you at any point during your movement.

feats.name: Primal Fury Style
feats.description: Your fury drives you to close with your foes so that you can tear into them more easily.
feats.prerequisites_text: Survival 3 ranks, one Primal Fury stance known.
feats.benefit: You can make Survival checks in place of Acrobatics checks to move through threatened squares. In addition, you can charge through difficult terrain and spaces containing opponents. You do not provoke attacks of opportunity for entering an opponent's space when charging, although you provoke attacks of opportunity as normal for moving through an opponent's threatened area.

feats.name: Prodigious Two-Weapon Fighting
feats.description: Your great physical might allows you to wield two large weapons with ease.
feats.prerequisites_text: Str 13.
feats.benefit: You may fight with a one-handed weapon in your offhand as if it were a light weapon. In addition, you may use your Strength score instead of your Dexterity score for the purpose of qualifying for Two-Weapon Fighting and any feats with Two-Weapon Fighting as a prerequisite.

feats.name: Ricochet Weapon
feats.prerequisites_text: Point-Blank Shot, Dex 13.
feats.benefit: Whenever you throw a weapon as part of a martial strike, that weapon bounces or ricochets off your target and returns to your hand at the end of your turn. You must have a free hand to be able to catch the weapon on its return, otherwise it falls into your space at your feet.

feats.name: Ripple in Still Water
feats.prerequisites_text: Ki pool class feature, kineticist level 1st.
feats.benefit: Your kineticist levels and your levels in the class that granted you the ki pool class feature stack for determining the number of points in your ki pool each day and the base damage of your kinetic blasts. In addition, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity for using your kinetic blast while threatened (neither from it being a spell-like ability nor from it being a ranged attack).

feats.name: Riven Hourglass Eternity
feats.description: Your grasp of time allows you to extend effects which benefit you.
feats.prerequisites_text: Riven Hourglass Style, Autohypnosis 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: Once per round, while you maintain a Riven Hourglass stance, you can expend a readied maneuver as a free action to extend the duration of one spell, power, or boost affecting you by one round. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Riven Hourglass Rewind
feats.description: You are able to reverse the flow of temporality to recover from debilitating effects for a short time.
feats.prerequisites_text: Riven Hourglass Style, Riven Hourglass Eternity, Autohypnosis 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: You can expend a readied counter as an immediate action to suppress one ongoing condition affecting you for one minute. This does not allow you to suppress the dead, dying, helpless or unconscious conditions. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Riven Hourglass Style
feats.description: Your understanding of temporal nature can give you insight into your enemies movements.
feats.prerequisites_text: Autohypnosis 5 ranks, one Riven Hourglass stance known.
feats.benefit: Whenever you miss an attack, you can expend a readied maneuver as an immediate action to reroll your attack roll. You must take the result of your second roll.

feats.name: Scarlet Throne Dignity
feats.prerequisites_text: Scarlet Throne Style, Sense Motive 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: You can expend a readied maneuver as an immediate action in response to an attack being made against you. If you do, make an attack roll with a weapon you are wielding. If your attack roll is higher than your opponent's, their attack is negated, and you can take a 5-foot step, even if you have already moved or taken a 5-foot step this round.

feats.name: Scarlet Throne Riposte
feats.description: You seize opportunity as it comes, taking advantage of your enemy's poor position after a missed attack.
feats.prerequisites_text: Scarlet Throne Style, Scarlet Throne Dignity, Sense Motive 11 Ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever you use an ability to negate an attack from an opponent (such as with a counter or with the Scarlet Throne Dignity feat), that opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you. A given creature can only provoke an attack of opportunity from you in this way once per round.

feats.name: Scarlet Throne Style
feats.description: Your skill with a single blade allows you to strike with the same force as those much stronger than you.
feats.prerequisites_text: Sense Motive 3 ranks, one Scarlet Throne stance known.
feats.benefit: As long as you only attack with a single weapon wielded in one hand during a round, you treat that weapon as if you were wielding it in two hands for the purposes of feats and abilities that would benefit from this change. This does not increase your Strength bonus to damage with the weapon.

feats.name: Scatter Power
feats.description: You create an eruption of gather power that infects those around you
feats.prerequisites_text: Gather power class feature, kineticist level 1st.
feats.benefit: When you successfully finish gathering power, you can choose to force the gathered energy into those around you in addition to using it to fuel your own abilities. Each adjacent creature must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your kineticist level + your Constitution modifier) or gain 1 point of burn, taking 1 point of nonlethal damage per Hit Die they possess, as usual for burn. If you gathered power as a full-round action, you may have this ability affects other creatures within 10 feet of you, instead of adjacent creatures. This feat is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Seize the Opportunity
feats.description: You possess an exceptional knack for exploiting sudden openings by your opponents.
feats.prerequisites_text: Combat Reflexes, base attack bonus +1.
feats.benefit: When you make an attack of opportunity, you can take an attack action (such as when using the Vital Strike feat) or attempt a combat maneuver (such as a bull rush, disarm or dirty trick) in place of your attack of opportunity. This feat does not allow you to move when it isn't your turn.

feats.name: Serene Stride
feats.description: Your ki allows for the lightest touch upon almost any surface.
feats.prerequisites_text: Ki pool, Wis 13.
feats.benefit: As long as you have at least one point in your ki pool you may ignore movement and Acrobatics penalties from difficult terrain and move across liquid surfaces just as if they were solid. You may still choose to swim if you wish to.

feats.name: Shattered Mirror Duality
feats.description: Your reality-distorting power reflects your attacks, making it hard to defend against you.
feats.prerequisites_text: Shattered Mirror Style, Shattered Mirror Waltz, Craft 13 ranks.
feats.benefit: Once per round, you can expend a readied boost as a swift action. If you do, you roll twice for each attack roll you make this round and use the better result. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Shattered Mirror Style
feats.description: You are skilled in the art of reflective combat.
feats.prerequisites_text: Craft 3 ranks, one Shattered Mirror stance known.
feats.benefit: When wielding one or more Shattered Mirror discipline weapons, your shield bonus to your AC increases by +2 (if you don't already have a shield bonus, you are considered to have a shield bonus of +0).

feats.name: Shattered Mirror Waltz
feats.description: Your supernatural swordplay lets you move like an illusion.
feats.prerequisites_text: Shattered Mirror Style, Craft 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: You ignore movement penalties from difficult terrain. Other effects of the terrain affect you as normal.

feats.name: Silver Crane Feathers
feats.description: You sacrifice yourself for others.
feats.prerequisites_text: Silver Crane Style, Perception 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever an ally within 30 feet would take ability damage or hit point damage, you can expend a readied counter as an immediate action to take the damage in place of that ally. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Silver Crane Style
feats.description: Your mercy shields your allies.
feats.prerequisites_text: Perception 3 ranks, one Silver Crane stance known.
feats.benefit: As a free action, you can choose to take a -1 penalty to your AC and on Reflex saves to grant other allies within 30 feet a +1 bonus to their AC and on Reflex saves until the start of your next turn. At character level 4th and at every four levels thereafter, this penalty increases by -1 and the bonuses granted increase by +1.

feats.name: Silver Crane Wing
feats.description: Your sacrifice to others grants you divine protection.
feats.prerequisites_text: Silver Crane Style, Silver Crane Feathers, Perception 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: When you use your Silver Crane Feathers feat you can make a Will save (DC equal to the ability damage dealt + the hit point damage dealt). If you succeed, the damage is negated rather than being redirected to you.

feats.name: Silver Fang Initiate
feats.description: You have learned how to combine talents from the Mithral Current and Steel Serpent disciplines.
feats.prerequisites_text: Quick Draw, two Mithral Current maneuvers known, two Steel Serpent maneuvers known.
feats.benefit: Whenever you use a Steel Serpent maneuver to deal ability score damage to a creature with vulnerability to silver, increase that ability score damage by 50%.

feats.name: Sin Eater
feats.description: You prosper as your enemies fail.
feats.prerequisites_text: Ability to Claim creatures.
feats.benefit: Whenever a creature Claimed by you is reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice that creature's Hit Dice. These temporary hit points last for one minute.

feats.name: Sleeping Goddess Slumber
feats.description: Your attacks drag your foe's mind into a dream world.
feats.prerequisites_text: Sleeping Goddess Style, Autohypnosis 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend your psionic focus as a free action. If you do, that creature must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your character level + your highest initiation modifier) or become confused for one round. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected by this feat for 24 hours. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Sleeping Goddess Strike
feats.description: Your strikes forge a temporary connection with the target, through which you can affect them more strongly.
feats.prerequisites_text: Sleeping Goddess Style, Sleeping Goddess Slumber, Autohypnosis 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever you hit an opponent with an attack, they take a -2 penalty on saving throws against your maneuvers until the end of their next turn.

feats.name: Sleeping Goddess Style
feats.description: You can tap into your mind to refresh your body.
feats.prerequisites_text: Autohypnosis 3 ranks, one Sleeping Goddess stance known.
feats.benefit: You gain psionic focus as a standard action. When you do, you recover recover an expended maneuver as a free action. If you have the Psionic Meditation feat, you can instead gain psionic focus and recover an expended maneuver as a move action.

feats.name: Solar Flare
feats.description: You can gather power, then emit a blinding flash of light.
feats.prerequisites_text: Gather power class feature, kineticist level 1st.
feats.benefit: When you successfully finish gathering power, you can emit a 20-foot burst of light that forces each creature within its area that can see you to make a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your kineticist level + your Constitution modifier) or become dazzled for 1 minute. If you gathered power as a full-round action, creatures that fail their saves are instead blinded for 1 round. When you use this feat, you choose the shape of the burst; it may be either a line, a cone, or a sphere around you (its range remains the same regardless). This feat is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Solar Wind Flash
feats.prerequisites_text: Solar Wind Style, Perception 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever you hit a creature with a ranged attack, you can expend one of your readied boosts as a swift action. If you do, that creature must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your character level + your highest initiation modifier) or become blinded for one round. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Solar Wind Inferno
feats.prerequisites_text: Solar Wind Style, Solar Wind Flash, Perception 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: Your ranged attacks ignore up to your character level in fire resistance. In addition, you can deal fire damage to creatures that are immune to fire, treating their immunity as fire resistance 30 for the purposes of this feat and dealing damage to them.
feats.special: If you have the Variable Wind feat, your ranged attacks ignore energy resistance of your active element's associated energy type, and you treat immunity to that energy type as resistance 30 to that energy type.

feats.name: Solar Wind Style
feats.description: Your arrows glow as bright as the sun.
feats.prerequisites_text: Perception 3 ranks, one Solar Wind stance known.
feats.benefit: Your ranged attacks deal 1 point of additional fire damage. At character level 5th and at every five levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1. In addition, whenever you hit a creature with a ranged attack, you can choose to have your target become outlined as if by a faerie fire spell, with a caster level equal to your initiator level. Successive uses of this ability against the same creature do not stack; instead, they extend the duration. You can suppress or resume the light on an affected creature you can see as a free action. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Steel Serpent Fangs
feats.description: You have honed your lethal intent to an art form.
feats.prerequisites_text: Steel Serpent Style, Heal 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: As a swift action, you can expend a readied boost to treat opponents suffering from ability damage as flat-footed until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Steel Serpent Style
feats.description: Your training lets you take advantage of weakened foes.
feats.prerequisites_text: Heal 3 ranks, one Steel Serpent stance known.
feats.benefit: Whenever you hit a creature with a Steel Serpent maneuver, that creature takes a -1 penalty on attack rolls and to their AC for two rounds. At character level 5th and at every five levels thereafter, this penalty increases by -1.

feats.name: Steel Serpent Venom
feats.description: You amplify the weakness of your victims.
feats.prerequisites_text: Steel Serpent Style, Steel Serpent Fangs, Heal 13 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever you deal weapon damage to a creature suffering from ability score damage, that creature must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your character level + your highest initiation modifier) or become nauseated for one round. Multiple uses of this effect do not stack, nor do they increase the duration.

feats.name: Syphon Vitality
feats.description: You can gather power from creatures instead of the environment.
feats.prerequisites_text: Gather power class feature, kineticist level 1st.
feats.benefit: When you gather power, you can choose to syphon the animating essence of opponents within 10 feet. When you successfully finish doing so, each creature within the area must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your kineticist level + your Constitution modifier) or become sickened for 1 round. If you gathered power as a full-round action, this sicken effect instead lasts for 1 minute. As this ability works by sapping the energy keeping a creature animate, it can still sicken creatures that are normally immune to being sickened. This feat is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Tactical Rush
feats.description: You are capable of making a fast sprint in the midst of combat, allowing you the ability to better position yourself.
feats.prerequisites_text: At least one maneuver known from the Iron Tortoise, Scarlet Throne, or Veiled Moon disciplines.

prerequisites.text: At least one maneuver known from the Iron Tortoise, Scarlet Throne, or Veiled Moon disciplines

feats.benefit: Once per encounter you may move up to your speed as a swift action.
feats.special: This feat may be taken up to three times, each time granting another use of this feat.

feats.name: Take the Blow
feats.description: You are swift in positioning yourself to aid your allies.
feats.prerequisites_text: Armiger's mark class feature.
feats.benefit: When a creature within your reach who is marked by your armiger's mark targets an ally with a melee or ranged attack, you can expend a use of your armiger's mark as an immediate action to force the opponent's attack to target you instead. You are considered the target for all effects of the attack (the creature must make a successful attack roll, you are allowed a save, if any, etc.).

feats.name: Tap Animus
feats.description: You gain the ability to tap a small wellspring of animus within you.
feats.prerequisites_text: You may not possess the animus class feature.

prerequisites.text: You may not possess the animus class feature

feats.benefit: When you enter combat, you gain an animus pool with one point of animus at the start of your first turn, and add one point of animus to your animus pool at the start of each of your turns thereafter. Your animus pool persists for one minute after the last enemy combatant is defeated or the encounter otherwise ends. At the end of any round in which you initiate a maneuver (a strike, boost, or counter), you add an additional point of animus to you pool. You can use this animus pool to augment maneuvers or power animus-related feats as normal.
feats.special: If you ever gain the animus class feature, this feat is immediately exchanged for the Extra Animus feat.

feats.name: Tempest Gale Haze
feats.prerequisites_text: Tempest Gale Style, Sleight of Hand 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: Ranged attacks against you suffer a 20% miss chance.

feats.name: Tempest Gale Storm
feats.description: You can fire off precisely aimed shots at rapid pace.
feats.prerequisites_text: Tempest Gale Style, Tempest Gale Haze, Sleight of Hand 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: You can make two different ranged combat maneuver attempts with your Tempest Gale Style feat against a single target as a standard action. You only provoke attacks of opportunity once when doing so.

feats.name: Tempest Gale Style
feats.description: Your arrows and slings are able to strike targets in unusual ways.
feats.prerequisites_text: Sleight of Hand 3 ranks, one Tempest Gale stance known.
feats.benefit: You can make bull rush, dirty trick, disarm, and trip attempts using a ranged weapon against any target within your first range increment. Attempting a combat maneuver in this way is a standard action that provokes an attack of opportunity (unless you have the appropriate improved combat maneuver feat). You use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for determining your combat maneuver bonus for these attempts.

feats.name: Thrashing Dragon Pounce
feats.description: Your swift movements allow you to close the gap and strike quickly against your foe.
feats.prerequisites_text: Thrashing Dragon Style, Acrobatics 7 ranks.
feats.benefit: Whenever you initiate a strike that requires you to make only single melee attack, you can make an additional attack with another weapon as a free action. This attack is made at your highest base attack bonus, although you take the penalties for fighting with two weapons as normal. This attack does not gain any of the benefits of the strike you initiated.

feats.name: Thrashing Dragon Style
feats.description: Your skill with two weapons makes you as dangerous as foes who wield one larger weapon.
feats.prerequisites_text: Acrobatics 3 ranks, one Thrashing Dragon stance known.
feats.benefit: Once per round, when you make an attack as a standard action or attack action, you can make an additional attack with another weapon as a free action. This attack is made at your highest base attack bonus, although you take the penalties for fighting with two weapons as normal.

feats.name: Thrashing Dragon Whirlwind
feats.description: Your fury strikes out at all enemies around you.
feats.prerequisites_text: Thrashing Dragon Style, Thrashing Dragon Pounce, Acrobatics 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: As a full-round action, you can make one melee attack with a weapon in your main hand and a weapon in your off hand against each opponent within reach. This attack is made at your highest base attack bonus, and you do not take the penalties for fighting with two weapons on these attacks.

feats.name: Unhindered Way
feats.description: You psionically augment your mobility in armor.
feats.prerequisites_text: Speed of Thought, proficiency with medium armor.
feats.benefit: Your speed is not reduced by medium and heavy armor, and you can gain the benefit of your Speed of Thought feat while wearing heavy armor.

feats.name: Variable Wind
feats.description: You've learned to use the many styles of the Solar Wind discipline.
feats.prerequisites_text: One Solar Wind maneuver known, one Solar Wind stance known.
feats.benefit: You gain the ability to change your active element if you cannot already. Any Solar Wind maneuver you initiate that deals fire damage instead deals damage of your active element's associated energy type.

feats.name: Veiled Moon Shunt
feats.description: You twist an enemy's location, shunting them into a dangerous position of weakness.
feats.prerequisites_text: Veiled Moon Style, Stealth 11 ranks.
feats.benefit: Once per round, when you hit with an attack, you can expend a readied maneuver as a free action to forcibly teleport your target. That creature must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + the expended maneuver's level + your highest initiation modifier) or be teleported to any unoccupied space within 30 feet of them that you can see. You need not teleport them to a location that can support them; you can teleport them into the air, into difficult terrain, or into dangerous situations as you see fit. This is a supernatural ability, and is considered a Veiled Moon maneuver for the purposes of save DCs and abilities such as the Discipline Focus feat.

feats.name: Veiled Moon Style
feats.description: Your secret knowledge of ethereal pathways allows you to slip through cracks in this world and come out the other side.
feats.prerequisites_text: Stealth 3 ranks, one Veiled Moon stance known.
feats.benefit: Whenever you move, you can treat up to 10 feet of that movement as teleportation. This teleportation may be taken at any point during your movement, and cannot exceed the total movement you would normally be allowed to make. You must have line of sight to your destination, and cannot teleport into an occupied space. This is a supernatural ability.
feats.special: You can use this feat to bypass a 5 feet worth of obstacles when making a charge; you treat a square you bypass as empty for the purposes of determining if you can charge your target.

feats.name: Veiled Moon Warp
feats.description: Your strikes can force an enemy into the aether for a short time.
feats.prerequisites_text: Veiled Moon Style, Veiled Moon Shunt, Stealth 15 ranks.
feats.benefit: As a standard action, you may expend one of your readied strikes and make a melee attack against an opponent. If it hits, deal weapon damage as normal and the target must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your highest initiation modifier) or become incorporeal for one round. The target can no longer grasp their weapons (unless they could be wielded by incorporeal creatures) but their other equipment remains on their body without becoming incorporeal, effectively rendering them incapable of using any items that do not have the ghost touch property or an equivalent effect. This is a supernatural ability.

feats.name: Victorious Recovery
feats.description: You learn how to use victory over a foe to your advantage, repositioning yourself and recovering a martial maneuver.
feats.prerequisites_text: Able to initiate maneuvers.
feats.benefit: Once per encounter, you may recover maneuvers equal to your initiator modifier when you reduce an opponent to zero or less hit points.

feats.name: Weaken the Prey
feats.prerequisites_text: One Cursed Razor, Eternal Guardian or Steel Serpent maneuver known.

prerequisites.text: Eternal Guardian or Steel Serpent maneuver known

feats.benefit: Cursed creatures, diseased creatures, and creatures suffering from ability damage take a -2 penalty on saving throws against your maneuvers.

feats.name: Weapon Group Adaptation
feats.description: You specialize in a specific family of weaponry, adapting many techniques to suit them.
feats.benefit: Choose a weapon group (excluding siege weapons and siege firearms). That weapon group is considered associated with disciplines you have access to.
feats.special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you take the feat, you choose a different weapon group to gain its benefits for. In addition, once you reach base attack bonus +5, this feat counts as the weapon training class feature with the chosen fighter weapon group for the purpose of Weapon Mastery feat prerequisites and what weapons you can use with weapon mastery feats.

feats.name: Winds of War
feats.prerequisites_text: Ability to Claim creatures.
feats.benefit: You gain a +5-foot bonus to each of your movement speeds. This bonus increases by +5 feet for each creature you currently have Claimed.

feats.name: Zealous Blade
feats.description: Your conviction fuels the power of the weapon you have idealized for your cause.
feats.prerequisites_text: Enhanced mind blade class feature, zeal class feature.
feats.benefit: You add your zealot level to your soulknife level to determine the enhancement bonus granted by your enhanced mind blade class feature, the maximum enhancement bonus of your mind blade, the effects of your blade skills, and which blade skills you can select.
